items.source: Common base class for Cache implementations that need to adapt null values (and potentially other such special values) before passing them on to the underlying store.
items.translation: 适用于需要在使用前将 `null` 值（以及可能存在的其他特殊值）适配后再传递给底层存储的 `Cache` 实现类的通用基类。

items.source: Abstract base class implementing the common CacheManager methods.
items.translation: 实现公共CacheManager方法的抽象基类。

items.source: Support classes for the open source cache in Caffeine library, allowing to set up Caffeine caches within Spring's cache abstraction.
items.translation: 支持开源缓存库 Caffeine 的辅助类，允许在 Spring 的缓存抽象中配置 Caffeine 缓存。
基于 java.util.concurrent 的缓存实现包。

items.source: Implementation package for JSR-107 (javax.cache aka "JCache") based caches.
items.translation: 基于缓存的 JSR-107（javax.cache 即"JCache"）实现包。

items.source: Support classes for the org.springframework.cache package.
Transaction-aware decorators for the org.springframework.cache package.
items.translation: org.springframework.cache 包的事务感知装饰器。
